evals.title: Open both trash can locks in the Vermilion Gym and reach Lt. Surge

objective.description: Two electric locks seal Lt. Surge's end of the Vermilion Gym. Find the switches hidden in the gym's trash cans, open both locks and walk up to Lt. Surge. You do not need to battle him. Wild encounters are disabled and the gym trainers are already beaten.

evals.start: The Vermilion Gym, just inside the door. Both electric locks are shut, every gym trainer is beaten and Lt. Surge is not.
success: Stand next to Lt. Surge, outside battle, after opening both electric locks.
failure: The decision cap or the token budget is reached before Lt. Surge.
The party blacks out. Infrastructure errors are recorded separately.
variants: One start. Pilot timing variants are added only if the pilot shows start sensitivity.
requirements: Capture the native start inside the Vermilion Gym door with both locks shut, the first switch under one fixed can and Lt. Surge unbeaten.
A scripted reference reaches every milestone with the same controls the model gets, choosing cans from the text it reads and never from RAM.
evals.task_family: Search hidden switches where a wrong second guess resets the first, then reach a sealed room
evals.agent_goal: Two electric locks seal Lt. Surge's end of the Vermilion Gym. Find the switches hidden in the gym's trash cans, open both locks and walk up to Lt. Surge. You do not need to battle him. Wild encounters are disabled and the gym trainers are already beaten.
scenario_details: Party: Wartortle level 25 with Tackle, Tail Whip, Bubble and Water Gun. Full HP, no status and full PP. Empty bag and no money.

Boulder and Cascade badges. Fifteen trash cans stand in five columns of three. For this start the first switch is under the top can of the middle column. When it opens, the game picks the second switch at random, usually under a can next to the first. Checking any other can then shuts the first lock again and moves the first switch to a random can.

Navigation-only condition: a documented emulator ROM override disables random wild encounters for the entire trial, and the three gym trainers are already beaten. Lt. Surge is not. No route hints or puzzle solutions are supplied.
open_questions: Check in the pilot whether the cap of five times the reference binds for strong models.
Check in the pilot whether models work out that the second switch sits next to the first, or restart the whole search after each reset.
evals.measures: Search a grid of hidden switches by reading the result text, remember which can opened the first lock, try its neighbors for the second and start again after a reset, then walk through the opened door to the leader.

milestones.description: Find the first switch and open the first electric lock.
Find the second switch and open the second electric lock.
Walk through the opened door and stand next to Lt. Surge.

evals.title: Reach the Safari Zone secret house and get HM03 in one entry

objective.description: You have just entered the Safari Zone with 500 steps. Find the secret house deep in the zone and get the HM the man there gives away. When the steps run out you are sent back to the gate, and you cannot afford a second entry, so the task fails if you return to the gate. Wild encounters are disabled.

evals.start: The Safari Zone center area, on the entrance tile from the gate, with 500 steps and 30 Safari Balls. HM03 has not been given and the player has too little money to pay for another entry.
failure: The player is back in the Safari Zone gate, whether the steps ran out or the player walked out.
The decision cap or the token budget is reached before HM03.
The party blacks out. Infrastructure errors are recorded separately.
variants: One start. Pilot timing variants are added only if the pilot shows start sensitivity.
requirements: Capture the native start on the center area's entrance tile with a fresh Safari game of 500 steps, HM03 not given and 200 money.
A scripted reference reaches every milestone with the same controls the model gets, within one entry.
evals.task_family: Find a hidden house across linked areas under a hard step budget, with no second try
evals.agent_goal: You have just entered the Safari Zone with 500 steps. Find the secret house deep in the zone and get the HM the man there gives away. When the steps run out you are sent back to the gate, and you cannot afford a second entry, so the task fails if you return to the gate. Wild encounters are disabled.
scenario_details: Party: Nidoking level 50 with Double Kick, Horn Attack, Poison Sting and Body Slam. Full HP, no status and full PP. Empty bag, 30 Safari Balls and 200 money, less than the 500 an entry costs.
Six badges, from Boulder to Marsh. The Safari game has just started with all 500 steps left. Every step in the zone counts, including steps inside its rest houses.
Navigation-only condition: a documented emulator ROM override disables random wild encounters for the entire trial. The Safari Zone has no trainers. No route hints are supplied.
open_questions: Check in the pilot whether the cap of five times the reference binds for strong models.
Check in the pilot whether models plan a route through the linked areas before the steps run out, or spend them exploring.
evals.measures: Plan a route across the linked Safari Zone areas to a house in the far corner while a 500-step counter runs, with no second entry, then speak to the man inside.

fail_on.description: Back in the Safari Zone gate with no money for a second entry

milestones.description: Reach the Safari Zone west area.
Get HM03 from the man in the secret house.
